mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes hypokalemia and hypomagnesemia which may increase rilpivirine QT prolongation risk; rilpivirine is a weak CYP3A4 substrate with potential for electrolyte-dependent cardiac effects.
action: Monitor serum potassium and magnesium levels regularly; consider potassium-sparing alternatives or supplementation; monitor ECG if QT prolongation risk factors present.
